name: Leasing: contracts & payments
description: Lease creation with eSignature (ML-DSA-65 signed), rent collection (Stripe → Polygon), deposits, screening.
functional_summary: Lease creation with eSignature (ML-DSA-65 signed), rent collection (Stripe → Polygon), deposits, screening.

user_stories.i_want: create a lease contract and collect rent
user_stories.so_that: the rental is formal and traceable

acceptance.criterion: Lease CRUD: tenant, start/end, rent, deposit, services included
Rent collection: invoice → payment (Stripe; later Polygon)

design.layout: [Lease list → detail: terms, services, deposit] / [Contract viewer with sign button] / [Invoices: create, status, pay] / [Payment history table]
components: @swal/ui: Card, Table, Modal, Button, Input, Badge, StatusBadge, Toaster
flow: Create lease → both parties eSign (ML-DSA-65) → invoice generated monthly → tenant pays (Stripe) → receipt → late reminder if overdue

acceptance.criterion: Lease CRUD: tenant, start/end, rent, deposit, services included
Rent collection: invoice → payment (Stripe; later Polygon)
